name: research-opportunity-platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=web && npm run typecheck --workspace=api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build

comment: npm workspaces, so the two deployable apps (web, api) can share packages/core and packages/server without either copying the other's code. Vercel detects this layout: set Root Directory to web/ for the frontend project and api/ for the data service, and it installs from here.
